changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Demand recovery and restocking were real, but the supply ceiling made the half-life uncertain rather than structural.
disconfirmingEvidence: All frozen lithium equities underperformed CSI300 over both 20/60d.

expectations.measurableGap: Company quality is strong, but the new rebound-to-profit bridge is not yet observed and the equity regime remains uniformly weak.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Fresh commodity-rebound earnings bridge plus peer quality; no clean valuation reset is frozen.

expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: New lithium rebound persists long enough to stabilize realized prices/margins into H1/Q3.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: The new commodity rebound—not legacy Q1 pricing—must produce a fresh margin/profit revision.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Supply caps prices and Q1 earnings decline sequentially even though spot lithium bounced.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: H1/Q3 realized lithium price and margin updates test the bridge.
